name: thehomie-root-harness
description: Root command surface for The Homie (PRPs/active/PRP-framework-harness-hardening-phase-1.md). Thin delegation ONLY — nested projects own their real config. Deliberately NOT an npm workspace: a `workspaces` key would claim ownership of the dashboard packages and change their install resolution. `lint` is scoped to the hard-gated core slices and is honestly RED until the Phase 2 clear-out (168 errors as of 2026-08-17); `security` verb ships in Phase 3 when a real scanner exists behind it.

scripts.setup: uv --directory .claude/scripts sync && npm --prefix dashboard/web install && npm --prefix dashboard/server install && npm --prefix dashboard/desktop install
scripts.lint: uv --directory .claude/scripts run ruff check runtime orchestration personas security
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix dashboard/web run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard/server run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix dashboard/web run build && npm --prefix dashboard/server run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
